subject.title: fix(cli): bound model run image reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: What Windows contract should this CLI promise for adversarially replaced `--file` paths: a race-safe nonblocking acquisition, or no new anti-blocking guarantee until a supported primitive is available?
rationale: The current pre-stat is not bound to the subsequent open, and Node does not expose the POSIX `O_NONBLOCK` behavior on Windows; selecting the supported fallback boundary is a platform/security policy decision rather than a mechanical edit.

options.title: Require a race-safe Windows design
options.body: Keep the availability claim only after implementing and proving an open-time Windows strategy that cannot be bypassed by replacing the path after validation.

options.title: Narrow the cross-platform claim
options.body: Retain the POSIX hardening and remove the Windows no-blocking assertion until maintainers approve a separately validated Windows design.

recommendation.title: Require a race-safe Windows design
recommendation.body: Keep the availability claim only after implementing and proving an open-time Windows strategy that cannot be bypassed by replacing the path after validation.
